node.title: Canonical low defects occupy small receiver-colour classes
node.statement: For finite full-code-bad supports in a fixed polynomial carrier, canonical maximum raw r<=T with2T<d forces all complete nonzero-evaluation defects into receiver-colour classes of size<=r. Zero-evaluation defect labels cost at most K-s globally. A proved r*beta tuple cost yields sum low raw <=[n_falling_(s+1)-(n-sigma_t)_falling_(s+1)]/beta, without a unique bank-entry assumption. No universal bank size or Prize claim.
